structured.answer: I'd take option ב: right to left, every amount sits on its own bar, step by step: what I put in, what the employer adds, the profit, the tax and what's left (66,513 ₪). In א I had to follow little lines from the numbers to thin coloured strips. Before joining anything I'd still ask my son.
